To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) automated eligibility screening can be performed with high precision and recall and 2) automated screening can significantly reduce the workload of oncologists and the number of trials they need to screen for a given patient.

we developed an automated eligibility screening (ES; a process of identifying patients who meet the eligibility criteria for a trial) algorithm that can be used in the Electronic Health Record and that the algorithm can reduce the workload of an oncologist by 85-90% compared to the historical workload.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of automated methods that can assist oncologists with the screening of patients for clinical trial eligibility.
the identification of patients who meet eligibility criteria for a clinical trial.
the identification and validation of an automated ES algorithm for oncology clinical trials that could significantly reduce the workload of oncologists in the trial-patient matching process.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the automated ES algorithm has the potential of reducing the effort to execute research by more than 80% and could significantly increase trial participation of oncology patients.
the use of NLP/IE technologies in clinical trial eligibility screening is a promising approach to increase the efficiency of trial enrollment and to expand access to cancer clinical trials.
the proposed automated eligibility screening method is an important step towards the goal of increasing the efficiency of trial enrollment and the overall success rate of clinical trials.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we developed a tool that can be used by oncologists to quickly identify the most relevant trials that a patient may be able to join.
automated ES could increase the efficiency of trial patient matching and thus increase the efficiency of clinical trial execution.
we have developed an algorithm for trial-patient matching that has the potential to greatly increase the efficiency of clinical trial enrollment, while maintaining a high level of sensitivity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
NLP/IE technologies can be used to improve the efficiency in clinical trial screening.
the use of automated trial-patient matching could be a powerful tool to increase trial enrollment, especially when considering the current trend towards more personalized medicine.
NLP and IE can help improve the efficiency of trial enrollment, which is critical to the success of clinical trials.
